title: Rolling Hills and Fields
description: A person sees a wide view of green fields in the foreground with patches of grass and small bushes. Beyond them are large bright yellow fields, a blue body of water, and distant blue and green mountains under a white sky.
prompt: A wide view of rolling green hills and fields in the foreground with patches of grass and small bushes, large bright yellow fields curving through the middle, a blue body of water, and distant blue and green mountains under a plain white sky, all drawn in a graphic illustration style with bold black outlines and flat areas of color.
